SQL:
SELECT
  stores.name AS "orders.stores.name",
  SUM(orders.subtotal) AS "orders.subtotal_sum",
  SUM(orders.subtotal) / 100.0 AS "orders.subtotal_dollars",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders._count",
  CAST(AVG(orders.subtotal) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.subtotal_avg"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN stores AS stores
  ON orders.store_id = stores.id
WHERE
  (
    orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
  )
GROUP BY
  stores.name
ORDER BY
  "orders.stores.name" ASC
LIMIT 21
